title: Bernoulli's Errors
coreMove: evaluate a choice from the reference point the person actually feels, not only from final wealth
sourcePressure: shows that classical utility theory misses how people evaluate gains and losses relative to a reference point
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: reducing this to money math instead of reference-dependent experience
